requirement:
`--config <name>` MUST select a configuration for that invocation. Otherwise,
authoring MUST use the user's selection for the canonical project root, then the
workspace default, then the user's default. Named workspace configurations MUST
override same-named user configurations as complete records. Backend, model,
connection settings, and options MUST come from the selected record as a unit;
fields MUST NOT be merged between records. Workspace-only authoring MUST work
without a user configuration file. Missing configuration or an unknown selection
MUST identify the relevant configuration file and point to documented examples.

An explicit Bedrock AWS profile or region MUST override the corresponding SDK
default; omitted values MUST use standard AWS SDK resolution. Ollama MUST use
its configured endpoint or `http://localhost:11434`. If `api_key_env` is set, its
named variable MUST supply the credential; a missing or empty value MUST produce
an error before a model request. OpenAI MUST use its configured endpoint or
`https://api.openai.com/v1`, and MUST resolve `OPENAI_API_KEY` when neither
`api_key` nor `api_key_env` is supplied.
rationale:
## Judgment
The selection logic conforms, but the OpenAI obligations lack tests carrying a reference to `requirements.authoring.configuration_precedence`. This is an unacknowledged coverage gap.

## Obligation mapping
- **Explicit selection; otherwise canonical-project selection, workspace default, then user default:** `src/config.rs#fn[resolve_authoring_from]` reaches `src/config.rs#fn[resolve_authoring_with_workspace_from]`, which canonicalizes the root and implements that ordered selection. Covered by `tests/configuration.rs#fn[explicit_project_and_default_selections_choose_whole_configs]` and `tests/configuration.rs#fn[workspace_defaults_and_configs_combine_with_existing_user_selections]`.
- **Workspace records override same-named user records completely; backend, model, connection settings, and options come from one record; fields are not merged:** the same resolver chooses a single record and clones its backend rather than combining fields. The preceding tests check backend/model replacement and absence of inherited endpoint settings; `tests/configuration.rs#fn[workspace_configurations_accept_validate_and_override_concurrency]` additionally checks whole-record replacement of concurrency. The options travel in the cloned backend, without a separate conditional or transformation.
- **Workspace-only authoring without a user file:** covered directly by `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file]`, as well as the workspace resolver test above.
- **Missing configuration identifies the relevant file and points to examples; unknown selection identifies the relevant file and points to examples:** the resolver constructs both diagnostics with source paths and `CONFIG_EXAMPLES`. Covered by `tests/configuration.rs#fn[explicit_project_and_default_selections_choose_whole_configs]`, `tests/configuration.rs#fn[configurations_without_any_selection_report_how_to_choose_one]`, and `tests/configuration.rs#fn[unknown_selections_name_the_file_that_made_them]`.
- **Explicit Bedrock profile overrides the SDK default; explicit region overrides the SDK default; omitted profile and omitted region use SDK resolution:** `src/authoring/providers.rs#fn[bedrock_sdk_config]` starts with SDK defaults and `src/authoring/providers.rs#fn[bedrock_sdk_loader]` applies only supplied overrides. Covered by `src/authoring/providers.rs#mod[tests]/fn[omitted_bedrock_profile_and_region_use_standard_sdk_resolution]` and `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bedrock_cli_uses_selected_profile_region_and_converse_tools]`.
- **Ollama configured endpoint or localhost default:** `src/config.rs#impl[OllamaConfig]/fn[endpoint]`, used by `src/authoring/providers.rs#impl[RigProvider]/fn[connect]`. Covered by the configured-endpoint CLI tests and `tests/configuration.rs#fn[backend_configuration_round_trips_without_materializing_defaults]` for the default.
- **A named `api_key_env` supplies the credential; missing and empty values error before a request:** `src/config.rs#impl[OllamaConfig]/fn[api_key_from]` and `src/config.rs#impl[OpenAiConfig]/fn[api_key_from]` resolve and reject values, and `RigProvider::connect` resolves keys while constructing providers. The Ollama path is covered by `tests/configuration.rs#fn[ollama_authentication_resolves_separately_and_rejects_missing_values]`, `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[missing_or_empty_api_key_env_fails_before_any_model_request]`, and the authenticated Ollama CLI test. The separate OpenAI path has no subject-marked test among the supplied tests.
- **OpenAI configured endpoint; OpenAI default endpoint; resolve `OPENAI_API_KEY` when neither key setting is supplied:** implemented by `src/config.rs#impl[OpenAiConfig]/fn[endpoint]` and `src/config.rs#impl[OpenAiConfig]/fn[api_key_from]`, used by `RigProvider::connect`.

## Specific gap
`tests/configuration.rs#fn[openai_configuration_preserves_model_and_resolves_credentials]` tests the OpenAI default endpoint and `OPENAI_API_KEY` fallback, but carries references only to other requirements—not the subject. It needs a `{test}` reference to `requirements.authoring.configuration_precedence`. None of the supplied subject-marked tests verifies OpenAI configured-endpoint selection or its named-variable credential/error path either. These paths contain conditional defaulting and validation, so the pass-through exemption does not apply. No supplied `{fixme}` acknowledges these coverage gaps.
